initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit ae562314cc, which added a Reference invariant row named "Minimum requirements" with error severity. Later R5 commits 1c4a35dbe2 and ab57a6ec66 normalized the wording and completed the current FHIRPath/XPath form, including extension allowance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Reference as a datatype, marks it normative, and assigns it code ref, so source/datatypes/reference.xml is build-scope current source. Generated R5 history contains ref-2 with the same rule. Zulip discussions in 2020 and 2022 align with the Jira/source conclusion and no direct Confluence reference to FHIR-22987 was found.
